reviews.title: Scorecard Suggestion
reviews.text: Love the app. As a diehard golfer, this is a service well worth paying for. One big quality of life suggestion, though. I’d love to not have to manually create a scorecard every time I play a new golf course. I feel like I should be able to search for a course and select the tee box from there, just like you do in every other app. If I were a city golfer playing a different course every week, I’d get annoyed with the tediousness pretty fast.

reviews.title: Love the app / Classy operation
reviews.text: Been enjoying the limited time I had with Stack Wedges and was looking forward to utilizing the strokes gained features, however I suffered a torn Achilles outside of golf. I reached out about a possibility of a “hold” on my subscription and they immediately added an additional 6 months and wished me well on my recovery.  So many other operations would just ignore me or say sorry can’t do anything about it but not TheStack. Thank you guys for the great app and being great humans.

reviews.title: New user

He sent me a video after working with me through the loading problems I was having.  The video did help and now I am enjoying the system.  It did gear a plan based upon my progression.  I would make one recommendation..for beginners and new users…- Give a written instruction document upon opening the box, such as: “Start here first”, with a decision matrix.  Not all people are visual and reading a quick 1, 2, 3… would have saved me a bit of frustration.  Thomas, thanks for your help and following up to make sure all was working properly!  I look forward to the improvements in my game!

reviews.title: App Review, not program review
reviews.text:
The stack program has yielded incredible results even 3-weeks in. 

However, the app is frustrating from a user experience standpoint. The most annoying thus far is that the reminder system is unintuitive to find and has stopped working altogether. Rather than relying on the reminders app, it should give the option to add the next workout as a .ics calendar appointment. This option should also be listed on the landing page and not hidden in the “preview workout” modal. Currently, when I try to create the reminder it keeps telling me a reminder already exists but I’ve only created two thus far. 

The next frustrating component is the lack of accessibility to the instructional videos. I as a user want to put on music and read the instructions of what moves to do in the warmup so I can reference them in the future as well as the instructions for the swing types.

What is also missing is a rough estimate of date of completion. I know that is dependent on when classes are taken but giving a best and worst case of dates gives more of a target. Additionally, just stating day of the week would be helpful rather than just date.

reviews.title: I just want to keep Stacking
reviews.text:
As a 12 handicap that’s been playing golf for about 4 years, I’ve never had speed or power. 

My Baseline for the Foundations course was 245 carry. I’m halfway through Foundations 1 and my carry potential is up to 275. I played golf last week and overshot two different greens because I’m gaining distance on approach shots from the Stack that I still haven’t implemented correctly in my club choice. 

I’m seeing speed and distance increases across the board. All I want to do is keep Stacking!

reviews.title: Must buy stack radar for full capabilities
reviews.text:
I bought the stack a little over a year ago. 2 weeks after they come out with a new radar after when I bought it they recommended the PRGR. Asked if they would give a deal on the new radar or trade in, but the deal they gave was very low so I didn’t do it. Not a big deal, because I can just voice record for speed, and the only upgrade was the Bluetooth connectivity. 

A year later they come out with a wedge app. Problem there is they force you to buy the new radar otherwise that portion of the app won’t even open up. You cannot even use that portion of the app with better simulators such as a trackman or GC quad basically upselling their own version of the PRGR with “Bluetooth connectivity”

Saw good gains over the first month and a half then was pretty much maxed out for speed. I was going to cancel, but then they hyped up the wedge app on my new Garmin R50, only to be let down and forced to buy another inferior monitor. It’s a shame because the do have good user interface and data, but the scam to get you to use their inferior launch monitor system is the downfall.

reviews.title: Stack is great but…
reviews.text: The threaded rod is poorly designed. What should take seconds (threading the yellow cap on to secure the weights) takes far longer because of the poor design of the threads. The top 1/4” should’ve unthreaded and smaller to allow the cap to easily thread directly on. Instead, it’s very either to cross thread or it isn’t aligned properly and you drop it.
